findings.text: BPF exposes TCP states as integers where name BPF_TCP_ESTABLISHED equals one and later states increase by one in declaration order through handshake and teardown and wait and close and listen phases plus new receive and bound inactive variants, ending with name BPF_TCP_MAX_STATES as count sentinel that stays last.

Socket operation options for TCP start at one thousand one where name TCP_BPF_IW sets initial window, and the next integer under name TCP_BPF_SNDCWND_CLAMP limits window, and the following integer under name TCP_BPF_DELACK_MAX bounds delayed ack in microseconds, and the next under name TCP_BPF_RTO_MIN bounds minimum retransmit timeout.

Continuing the same consecutive numbering, name TCP_BPF_SYN copies only TCP header while name TCP_BPF_SYN_IP adds network header and name TCP_BPF_SYN_MAC further adds link header, then name TCP_BPF_SOCK_OPS_CB_FLAGS accesses operation callback flags and name SK_BPF_CB_FLAGS accesses socket flags and name SK_BPF_BYPASS_PROT_MEM accesses bypass memory control, occupying one thousand five through one thousand ten in order.

SYN retrieval for sock ops programs hides whether bytes come from the just received packet during synack generation or from an earlier saved copy, reports total copied length on success, signals truncation when user buffer is too small, and signals absence when no live packet exists and no prior save was performed, with IP parsing avoidable by requesting TCP only.
Header option load control provides a single sixty four bit mask where name BPF_LOAD_HDR_OPT_TCP_SYN selects TCP SYN handling using bit zero.

Header rewrite mode distinguishes value one under name BPF_WRITE_HDR_TCP_CURRENT_MSS meaning kernel measures option space for MSS without transmitting, from value two under name BPF_WRITE_HDR_TCP_SYNACK_COOKIE meaning kernel emits SYN in syncookie mode.
Performance snapshot contains three unsigned sixty four bit values where field counter stores current count and field enabled stores enabled time and field running stores running time.
Device control access mask uses bit zero for name BPF_DEVCG_ACC_MKNOD and bit one for name BPF_DEVCG_ACC_READ and bit two for name BPF_DEVCG_ACC_WRITE.
Device control type mask uses bit zero for block under name BPF_DEVCG_DEV_BLOCK and bit one for character under name BPF_DEVCG_DEV_CHAR.
Device context with fields access_type plus major plus minor uses thirty two bits each, where access_type packs access rights shifted by sixteen together with device type.
Raw tracepoint argument block presents a flexible array of sixty four bit slots with zero declared length for variable argument access.

Forwarding lookup tuning uses bit zero for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_DIRECT and bit one for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_OUTPUT and bit two for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_SKIP_NEIGH and bit three for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_TBID and bit four for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_SRC and bit five for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_MARK and bit six for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_VLAN and bit seven for name BPF_FIB_LOOKUP_VLAN_INPUT.

Result codes are consecutive from zero where name BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_SUCCESS equals zero for lookup success and each following outcome increments by one through blackhole and unreachable and prohibit and not forwarded and forwarding disabled and unsupported tunnel and missing neighbor and fragmentation needed and missing source, ending with VLAN failure at ten.

Intermediate result names in order are BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_BLACKHOLE then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_UNREACHABLE then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_PROHIBIT then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_NOT_FWDED then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_FWD_DISABLED then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_UNSUPP_LWT then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_NO_NEIGH then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_FRAG_NEEDED then BPF_FIB_LKUP_RET_NO_SRC_ADDR.

Forwarding lookup parameter block begins with family and layer four protocol plus source and destination ports, followed by a length versus MTU selector and an interface index and a service versus flow versus metric selector and source and destination address selectors for IPv4 or IPv6 and a VLAN versus table selector and a mark versus hardware address selector.

Same memory serves different directions where length and ingress index and service and addresses enter lookup while MTU and egress index and metric and resolved source and gateway and VLAN or hardware addresses leave it, with length sharing sixteen bits packed and aligned to two and network order kept for addresses and ports and VLAN tags and VLAN fields zeroed on success without VLAN flag and table identifier honored only with direct plus table flags.

Neighbor redirect descriptor holds a thirty two bit family followed by a nexthop selector holding either a thirty two bit IPv4 value in network order or four thirty two bit IPv6 words in network order, allowing direct neighbor use without route lookup.
MTU check control defines name BPF_MTU_CHK_SEGS on bit zero to include segment handling.
MTU outcomes number zero for name BPF_MTU_CHK_RET_SUCCESS and one for name BPF_MTU_CHK_RET_FRAG_NEEDED and two for name BPF_MTU_CHK_RET_SEGS_TOOBIG.

Task descriptor types in order are name BPF_FD_TYPE_RAW_TRACEPOINT and name BPF_FD_TYPE_TRACEPOINT and name BPF_FD_TYPE_KPROBE and name BPF_FD_TYPE_KRETPROBE and name BPF_FD_TYPE_UPROBE and name BPF_FD_TYPE_URETPROBE starting at zero, where tracepoints use names and kernel probes use symbol plus offset or address and user probes use filename plus offset.
Dissector flags place name BPF_FLOW_DISSECTOR_F_PARSE_1ST_FRAG on bit zero and name BPF_FLOW_DISSECTOR_F_STOP_AT_FLOW_LABEL on bit one and name BPF_FLOW_DISSECTOR_F_STOP_AT_ENCAP on bit two.

Flow key record stores network and transport offsets and address ethertype and fragmentation and encapsulation indicators and IP protocol and network protocol and ports, followed by an address selector for IPv4 pair or IPv6 quad words, plus flags and flow label, with network order for protocols and ports and IPv4 values and IPv6 words.
Function debug entry pairs a thirty two bit instruction offset with a thirty two bit type identifier.
Packing uses name BPF_LINE_INFO_LINE_NUM to shift right by ten for line and name BPF_LINE_INFO_LINE_COL to mask low ten bits for column.
Line record holds instruction offset plus file name offset plus line offset plus packed line column, each thirty two bits.
Spin synchronization primitive is a single thirty two bit value.

Timer and work queue and dynamic pointer handles hide kernel state behind opaque sixty four bit arrays with eight byte alignment, where timer and work queue and dynamic pointer each reserve two words and task work and iterator number each reserve one word.

List and tree and reference handles similarly use opaque storage with list head and tree root reserving two sixty four bit words and list node three words and tree node four words all aligned to eight, while reference count reserves one thirty two bit word aligned to four.
Sysctl context reports direction with zero for read and one for write plus file position, allowing narrow reads of one two or four bytes but only four byte writes.
Socket option context carries socket pointer plus value start and end pointers plus level and name and length and return code as signed thirty two bit integers.
Process namespace identity pairs process identifier with thread group identifier as thirty two bit values.

Socket lookup context starts with a selector holding either chosen socket pointer or nonzero test cookie, followed by family and protocol, remote IPv4 and IPv6 in network order plus remote port in network order with sixteen bits zero padding, local IPv4 and IPv6 in network order plus local port in host order, and ingress interface index.
Remote addresses and remote port use network order while local port uses host order and the sixteen bits after remote port must be zero, with ingress index derived from input device.
Type tagged pointer bundles an untyped address with a thirty two bit type identifier and thirty two bit flags currently unused.
Display control uses bit zero for name BTF_F_COMPACT and bit one for name BTF_F_NONAME and bit two for name BTF_F_PTR_RAW and bit three for name BTF_F_ZERO.

Relocation kinds are zero based where name BPF_CORE_FIELD_BYTE_OFFSET is zero and each declared kind increments by one through field size and existence and signedness and shifts and type identifiers and existence and size and enum checks, ending with name BPF_CORE_TYPE_MATCHES at twelve.

Kind names in order are BPF_CORE_FIELD_BYTE_OFFSET then BPF_CORE_FIELD_BYTE_SIZE then BPF_CORE_FIELD_EXISTS then BPF_CORE_FIELD_SIGNED then BPF_CORE_FIELD_LSHIFT_U64 then BPF_CORE_FIELD_RSHIFT_U64 then BPF_CORE_TYPE_ID_LOCAL then BPF_CORE_TYPE_ID_TARGET then BPF_CORE_TYPE_EXISTS then BPF_CORE_TYPE_SIZE then BPF_CORE_ENUMVAL_EXISTS then BPF_CORE_ENUMVAL_VALUE then BPF_CORE_TYPE_MATCHES.
Relocation entry combines instruction offset and type identifier and access string offset as thirty two bit values with a relocation kind discriminator.
Timer creation uses bit zero for name BPF_F_TIMER_ABS for absolute expiry and bit one for name BPF_F_TIMER_CPU_PIN for pinning to current CPU.
Kernel function call flags provide name BPF_F_PAD_ZEROS on bit zero to zero pad.
Instruction address mapping stores original offset plus translated offset plus jitted offset as thirty two bit values with thirty two bits padding.

Classes assign zero to name BPF_LD and one to name BPF_LDX and two to name BPF_ST and three to name BPF_STX and four to name BPF_ALU and five to name BPF_JMP and six to name BPF_RET and seven to name BPF_MISC.
Extractor name BPF_SIZE masks with hexadecimal one eight while name BPF_W selects thirty two bits at zero and name BPF_H selects sixteen bits at eight and name BPF_B selects eight bits at sixteen.

Addressing modes assign zero to name BPF_IMM and hexadecimal two zero to name BPF_ABS and hexadecimal four zero to name BPF_IND and hexadecimal six zero to name BPF_MEM and hexadecimal eight zero to name BPF_LEN and hexadecimal a zero to name BPF_MSH.

Arithmetic operations step by hexadecimal one zero from name BPF_ADD at zero then name BPF_SUB then name BPF_MUL then name BPF_DIV then name BPF_OR then name BPF_AND then name BPF_LSH then name BPF_RSH then name BPF_NEG then name BPF_MOD to name BPF_XOR at hexadecimal a zero.
Jump operations step by hexadecimal one zero from name BPF_JA at zero then name BPF_JEQ then name BPF_JGT then name BPF_JGE to name BPF_JSET at hexadecimal four zero.
Operand source distinguishes constant at zero under name BPF_K from register at eight under name BPF_X.
Classic program length is capped at four thousand ninety six instructions under name BPF_MAXINSNS.
Perf event context for programs carries user register snapshot plus sample period plus address where period and address are sixty four bit values.

Gateway defines protocol zero under name BSG_PROTOCOL_SCSI with subprotocol zero under name BSG_SUB_PROTOCOL_SCSI_CMD and one under name BSG_SUB_PROTOCOL_SCSI_TMF and two under name BSG_SUB_PROTOCOL_SCSI_TRANSPORT.
Queue placement uses hexadecimal one zero under name BSG_FLAG_Q_AT_TAIL for tail and hexadecimal two zero under name BSG_FLAG_Q_AT_HEAD for head, with head as default.

Fourth generation pass through record opens with guard and protocol and subprotocol and command length and address and tag and attributes and priority and spare, continues with response capacity and address, then data out and data in vector counts and lengths and addresses, then timeout and flags and opaque user pointer and spare input, and closes with driver and transport and device statuses plus retry delay and info and duration and response length and input and output residuals and generated tag and spare output plus padding.

Guard must carry letter Q to distinguish from prior version, zero vector count means flat transfer while nonzero means pointer to vector array, dout fields describe host to device and din opposite, and residuals report requested minus actual lengths with durations in milliseconds.

Uring variant orders command address and length plus protocol and subprotocol and response capacity, then response address, then data out address and length and count, then data in address and length and count, then timeout in milliseconds and twelve reserved bytes for extension.

Sixty four bit secondary result packs device status in low eight bits and driver status in next eight and host status in next eight and sense length in next eight with residual length in upper thirty two, with accessors extracting each slice and a builder composing them from five inputs.
Blob starts with magic hexadecimal e B nine F under name BTF_MAGIC and version one under name BTF_VERSION.

BTF header holds sixteen bit magic plus eight bit version and flags plus thirty two bit header length followed by paired offset and length for type and string and layout sections, where all offsets count bytes from header end.
Layout descriptor records single element info size and per element size as eight bit values plus sixteen bit flags currently unused.

Limits cap kind at hexadecimal seven F under name BTF_MAX_KIND and type identifier at hexadecimal F FFFF under name BTF_MAX_TYPE and name offset at hexadecimal FFFFFF under name BTF_MAX_NAME_OFFSET and variable length at hexadecimal FFFFFF under name BTF_MAX_VLEN.

Type record carries name offset and info word plus a selector holding either size or referenced type, where info packs variable length in low twenty four bits and kind in next six bits and top flag for struct and union and enum and forward and enum sixty four and tag forms, with size meaningful for integer and enum and struct and union and section and enum sixty four while reference meaningful for pointer and typedef and qualifiers and function and prototype and variable and tags.

Type kinds number from zero for unknown under name BTF_KIND_UNKN through integer and pointer and array and struct and union and enum and forward and typedef and volatile and const and restrict and function and prototype and variable and section and float and declaration tag and type tag to enum sixty four at nineteen under name BTF_KIND_ENUM64, with a count marker after and a max defined as count minus one.

Kind names in order are BTF_KIND_UNKN then BTF_KIND_INT then BTF_KIND_PTR then BTF_KIND_ARRAY then BTF_KIND_STRUCT then BTF_KIND_UNION then BTF_KIND_ENUM then BTF_KIND_FWD then BTF_KIND_TYPEDEF then BTF_KIND_VOLATILE then BTF_KIND_CONST then BTF_KIND_RESTRICT then BTF_KIND_FUNC then BTF_KIND_FUNC_PROTO then BTF_KIND_VAR then BTF_KIND_DATASEC then BTF_KIND_FLOAT then BTF_KIND_DECL_TAG then BTF_KIND_TYPE_TAG then BTF_KIND_ENUM64.
Integer encoding uses bit zero under name BTF_INT_SIGNED for signed and bit one under name BTF_INT_CHAR for character and bit two under name BTF_INT_BOOL for boolean.

Enumeration entry pairs name offset with signed thirty two bit value, array descriptor triples element type and index type and element count, and member descriptor triples name offset and type plus bit offset or combined size and offset when kind flag is set.
Function parameter pairs name offset with type, variable info holds linkage code, and section variable info triples type and offset and size, all thirty two bits each.
Declaration tag holds signed component index, while sixty four bit enum entry holds name offset plus low and high halves of value.

Variable linkage numbers zero under name BTF_VAR_STATIC and one under name BTF_VAR_GLOBAL_ALLOCATED and two under name BTF_VAR_GLOBAL_EXTERN, while function linkage numbers zero under name BTF_FUNC_STATIC and one under name BTF_FUNC_GLOBAL and two under name BTF_FUNC_EXTERN.
Big endian identification defines numeric code four three two one under name __BIG_ENDIAN and a bitfield ordering marker under name __BIG_ENDIAN_BITFIELD.
Each user visible header uses a unique include guard macro to prevent multiple inclusion.

Reusing same storage for inputs and outputs in forwarding and flow and socket lookup records risks stale bytes if caller assumes separate fields, especially VLAN versus table and mark versus hardware addresses and length versus MTU sharing.
User pointers embedded in pass through and uring records plus variable vector arrays require validation of lengths and counts, otherwise truncated or oversized transfers and info leaks occur.
BTF offsets and lengths are relative and bounded by maxima, so unchecked name offsets or type identifiers or variable lengths allow out of bounds reads.
